result.topic_en: Beginning of the solution for the general motion of a flexible thread in a plane, where the endpoint A is no longer fixed and the tangent angle φ must be treated as a function of both arc length s and time t.

items.english: ...may be determined, where we assume that the whole motion always takes place in the same plane in which the figure of the thread itself lies.

items.english: Now it is evident that this angle φ can no longer be regarded as a function of the arc s, since to the same arc AM = s different angles φ correspond at different times; rather, the angle φ must be taken as a function of two variables, s and t.
